preamble: Editorial still-life photography on a seamless warm off-white cyclorama. Large soft overhead source, huge white bounce, near-shadowless with one soft contact shadow. High key, gentle contrast, warm white and pale neutral grade. Medium-format sharpness, fine grain. Photographic realism, no CGI, no text, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: A single classic hydraulic barber chair standing alone on the warm off-white cyclorama, seen from the front three-quarter with the camera at seat height. The chair is unmistakably a professional barber chair: wide padded black leather seat, tall padded backrest with a padded headrest on top, padded armrests, a hydraulic pump under the seat with a chrome lever on the side, a heavy round polished chrome base plate on the floor and a chrome footrest bar in front. Early morning: in addition to the soft overhead source, a pale cool daylight comes from a tall window out of frame on the left, giving a gentle cool cast on the leather and chrome and one long soft shadow stretching to the right. The whole chair fits inside the right third of the frame with plain pale floor around it, not cropped; the left two thirds are plain empty pale cyclorama with nothing on it, large empty space for text. No people, no mirror, no trolley, no other objects, no text, no logos.

Image-to-image relight of the reference: keep the same classic hydraulic barber chair (padded black leather seat, tall backrest with padded headrest, padded armrests, hydraulic pump with chrome lever, heavy round polished chrome base plate, chrome footrest bar) exactly the same size, at exactly the same position and scale in the frame, the same camera distance and height, the same framing and the same warm off-white cyclorama; do not move the camera, do not zoom in, do not enlarge the chair. Only the light changes: midday, bright even soft light from directly above, almost no shadow, neutral warm-white grade without any colour cast, no window glow on the left. The chair stays inside the right third of the frame with plain pale floor around it; the left two thirds remain plain empty pale cyclorama for text. No people, no other objects, no text, no logos.

Wide interior of a small bright hair salon: three identical styling chairs with black leather seats in a row in front of three large round frameless mirrors on a plain warm off-white wall, a pale wooden counter under the mirrors, light oak floor. Seen straight on from the middle of the room, camera at chest height. Bright soft daylight from large windows out of frame, near-shadowless, warm white grade. The chairs and mirrors occupy the lower two thirds of the frame; the upper third is plain pale wall, empty space for text. No people, no reflections of people in the mirrors, no posters, no text, no signs, no logos, no plants.
